scientific_integrity: The field/characteristic split, projective Jacobian schemes, exact affine chart computations, cohomology and Hilbert series are stated with their hypotheses. The accompanying checks are supporting finite and symbolic tests; there is no independent audit or external mathematical certification.
scientific_limitations: The algebraic proof concerns one symmetric 3-by-3 permanent; the second-Veronese K3 carpet exists only in characteristic two, whereas the odd-characteristic singular scheme is a three-conic arrangement with three embedded length-one points. General K3-carpet deformations and other matrix sizes are not classified. Literature uniqueness is unproved, especially for characteristic-two symmetric-determinantal Jacobian schemes.
title: Characteristic-two Veronese K3 carpet in the singular scheme of a symmetric permanent
